properties.name: reasoning_report reserves its summary's room, keeps names to 80 characters, and keeps to its budget
properties.rationale: Root cause, recorded on fact:the-zero-rung-blanks-every-name-over-80-characters-so-a-reasoning-summary-reads-as-dots-2026-10-25 and its recurrence fact:reasoning-report-at-6000-blanked-its-summary-and-answered-9529-characters-2026-10-27: the claims page took the budget first, the summary got 0 room, the last prose rung cut every string over 80 characters to "…", and a claim larger than the budget was kept whole, so the reply went over. Fixed with option (a): names never below 80, the summary's room before a claim, and zero claims plus where to read on when one claim cannot fit. Keeps req:the-reasoning-read-back-keeps-the-words-of-the-claims-it-returns (no claim is ever cut) and is a step toward req:no-reply-grows-with-the-design-each-fills-its-budget-and-says-how-to-read-on, not its completion. Additive on the wire: one new page field; next_offset can now equal offset when no claim fits, which the page explains. Before/after: the test fails on main 983811cae (13,534 characters to 6,000) and passes after. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: reply_budget::bound_reply_sampling_floor (prose rungs stop at a floor, NEVER_TRIM_BELOW = 80, instead of 0). reasoning_page: when one whole claim and the whole summary pass the budget, the summary is fitted with that floor (fit_summary_beside_claims); when one claim still will not fit beside the summary at its floor, the page returns no claim, the summary, next_offset at that claim, and page.claim_needs_budget_chars (rounded up past what it measured), said in page.reads. A budget below the summary's own floor is answered at that floor and page.reads says so (dec:loop-status-keeps-its-floor-2026-10-27). Test: a_reasoning_summary_keeps_its_room_and_the_budget.rs.
